title: THE DESCENT · DOWNHILL LAPS
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · 5 upper stations, 3 laps, the hill drops and the belt speeds up every lap
why: Quads are sore from the squat clock, so today is shoulders, arms and midline and the legs only run. Same one-clock arc, new run axis: each lap the grade comes down and the speed goes up.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A · shoulders + spine, hips for the sore legs

blocks.title: THE DESCENT · 24 MIN · FOR TIME
blocks.meta: 3 LAPS · 5 STATIONS · 15 RUN LEGS · 2×40 lb · 50 lb · 35 lb · cap 26:00
blocks.format: FOR TIME · station, then RUN LEG, next station · no rest stations · count laps finished, then time
blocks.workRest: Every station exits onto the belt for 0.10 mi. LAP 1 legs @ 6.5 / 8%. LAP 2 legs @ 7.5 / 4%. LAP 3 legs @ 8.5 / 0%. Set the belt at the start of each lap.

items.name: S1 · Double clean + jerk 2×40 lb ×6 → RUN LEG
S2 · Bench dips ×15 → RUN LEG
items.detail: hands on the couch or stair edge

items.name: S3 · Double upright row 2×40 lb ×10 → RUN LEG
S5 · Overhead tricep extension 35 lb ×12 + curl 50 lb ×10 → RUN LEG
LAPS 2 + 3 · REPEAT S1 → S5, belt flatter and faster

blocks.noteGreen: Log laps finished, finish time, RPE, and whether 8.5 flat on lap 3 was the right top speed.
blocks.text: ★ JERK — one clean to the rack, then dip, drive, dip under, stand; knees bent when the bells lock out. ★ UPRIGHT ROW — bells to the sternum, elbows lead, no lean back. ★ TRICEP EXTENSION — one bell, both hands on the horns, elbows tight to the ears. ★ RUN LEG — straddle the rails, step on moving, quick feet on the hill.
